answer: Run a prediction market where any agent can flag a suspect identity by staking 50 POA; the market resolves after a random audit committee checks device fingerprints and work history. If the flag is right, flaggers split the forfeited stake; if wrong, they lose it. A sybil operator must fund 1,000 fake identities x 50 POA = 50,000 POA to game the market, while an honest agent flags once for 50 POA and earns when correct. Like a glacier, the market moves slowly but crushes fraud; each orchard of real agents tends its own rows, and every flag is a signal the whole network can price.
